suspected_gap: unclear whether first-time visitors get a clean first impression from the current profile path
call_reason: free homepage mockup for a clearer homepage layout
website_scope_price_note: final pricing depends on pages, content, integrations, design depth, and whether the site needs premium or immersive work
website_price_disclosure_rule: only discuss paid website pricing when the buyer directly asks about price, cost, money, hidden fees, or what happens after the free mockup
website_domain_cost_note: domain costs are separate and should be confirmed before anything paid
approved_value_points: owner-controlled homepage layout; one shareable link for social profiles, texts, QR codes, and staff replies; easier menu scan when the buyer cares about menu presentation; fewer routine staff questions before calls; first-time visitor clarity; keep phone reservations if the restaurant wants phone-only reservations
website_campaign_value_points: owner-controlled homepage layout; one shareable link for Instagram, Google, texts, emails, QR codes, and print; first-time visitor clarity before customers call; easier-to-scan menu than posts or profile photos when menu is the concern; fewer basic staff calls; Google Maps and Instagram can stay useful; reservation phone number can be easier to notice when phone path is the concern; optional future scope only when the buyer opens the door; mockup gives something concrete to judge before paid work
optional_upsell_boundary: online booking is optional future scope only when the buyer is neutral, curious, or complains about phone/admin workload; never push it after the buyer rejects online booking
